title: The Grand Pearl
meta_description: Find the perfect 30A, FL vacation rental at ‘The Grand Pearl’ a Luxury 8 Bedroom, 9.5 Bathroom vacation rental. Ideal for 29 guests, this home offers unobstructed gulf views, a private pool, & 6-seater golf cart.
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: • Brand New Construction • Private Pool & Covered Spa (Pool can be heated for an additional $70 per day from October 1 - May 1) • 3 Minute Walk to the Beach • 4 Stories & 7,554 Square Feet • 6-Seater Golf Cart & 6 Adult Bikes Included • Elevator • Parking for 6 Vehicles SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (Sleeps 29) FIRST FLOOR: (Sleeps 2) • Primary Suite with King Bed (sleeps 2) and ensuite bathroom with double vanity, modern soaking tub vanity and walk-in glass/tile shower – Access to Pool Deck SECOND FLOOR: (Sleeps 18) • King Guest Suite (sleeps 2) and ensuite bathroom with single vanity and walk-in glass/tile shower + Balcony with Gulf Views • King Guest Suite (sleeps 2) and ensuite bathroom with single vanity and walk-in glass/tile shower + Balcony with Gulf Views • King Guest Suite (sleeps 2) and ensuite bathroom with single vanity and walk-in glass/tile shower + Balcony with Gulf Views • Primary King Suite (sleeps 2) and ensuite bathroom with double vanity, modern soaking tub enclosed in an expansive tile/glass shower + laundry facilities & Balcony with Gulf Views • Large Bunk Room (sleeps 6) with One Queen over Queen Bunk & One Twin over Twin Bunk and ensuite bathroom with single vanity and walk-in glass/tile shower • Bunk Room (sleeps 4) with Two Twin over Twin Bunks and shared bathroom with single vanity and walk-in glass/tile shower FOURTH FLOOR (Sleeps 9) • Media Room with Three Twin Over Twin Bunks (sleeps 6) – Access to Fourth Floor Balcony overlooking the Gulf. • King Guest Suite (sleeps 2) & overhead Full Bed (sleeps 1) and shared bathroom with single vanity and walk-in glass/tile shower LAYOUT: -First Floor Impressions- The first floor of The Grand Pearl invites you into a space designed for relaxation and effortless entertaining. Warm wood ceilings and an open-concept den create a welcoming atmosphere, with comfortable seating and an expansive wall of glass that blurs the line between indoor and outdoor living. This design floods the space with natural light and connects seamlessly to the backyard. A secondary kitchen on this level is equipped with a custom island, refrigerator/freezer, ice maker, dishwasher, and drink cooler—perfect for hosting gatherings. A shuffleboard table adds a touch of interactive fun. Down the hallway, a striking pool bath with black sliced rock flooring is accessible from both the interior and the pool deck. An elevator services the first three floors, ensuring convenience. The ground-level primary suite, complete with a King bed, offers direct access to the pool deck and covered spa area, ideal for early morning swims or evening relaxation. The nearby laundry room is fully equipped with two sets of washers and dryers, a utility sink, and open shelving for added convenience. -Outdoor Oasis- Step outside The Grand Pearl to your private resort-style retreat. The centerpiece is a 30' x 26' heated pool, featuring a tanning ledge, bench seating, and a fire-and-water feature wall that adds dramatic flair. The adjacent 16' x 9' spa is covered and equipped with 16 jets, providing a relaxing escape. For sunbathers, an open area offers ample sunshine, while a fully equipped outdoor summer kitchen with a premium gas grill, refrigerator, ice maker, and sink ensures seamless outdoor entertaining. An outdoor TV and integrated surround sound enhance the entertainment options, while the spacious fenced yard offers room for games and gatherings. Though beach access isn’t directly available through the yard, it’s just a short three-minute walk through the neighborhood. After a day at the beach, rinse off in the convenient outdoor shower. -Second Floor Serenity- The second floor of The Grand Pearl features three Gulf-facing guest suites, each with a King bed, en-suite bathroom, and access to a shared balcony with stunning views. The primary suite on this level is a true retreat, complete with a spa-inspired bathroom and its own washer/dryer. Step out onto a spacious balcony area with seating perfect for morning coffee or sunset views. A cozy bunk room with two sets of twin-over-twin bunks is located down the hall, along with a hallway coffee bar and shared bathroom. A large bonus bunk suite with a full-over-full bunk and twin-over-twin bunk, plus an attached bathroom, provides flexible accommodations for larger groups. -Third Floor Luxury- The third floor serves as the entertainment hub of The Grand Pearl. Soaring ceilings with exposed beams crown an open-concept design that integrates the kitchen, dining, living, and outdoor spaces. The gourmet kitchen boasts custom cabinetry, a butler’s pantry, premium Monogram appliances, and a stunning waterfall-edge quartz island. The dining area transitions to a dramatic living space, where a floor-to-ceiling tiled fireplace adds a touch of elegance. A fully stocked bar with dual beverage refrigerators and a herringbone backsplash enhances hosting opportunities. Glass doors open to a covered outdoor living area, featuring a summer kitchen, dining table, gas fire pit, and lounge seating. -Fourth Floor Fun- The fourth floor offers a private retreat within The Grand Pearl, featuring a spacious den with a sectional sofa and a framed TV for movie nights. Integrated into the design are three custom-built twin-over-twin bunks, creating a unique multifunctional space. Adjacent to the den, a private suite includes a King bed with an additional twin XL bunk above it, plus a full bathroom with a walk-in shower. A covered porch offers quiet moments and panoramic Gulf views, completing this level’s charm. The Grand Pearl is thoughtfully designed to offer the perfect blend of luxury, comfort, and coastal living for seasoned travelers seeking an exceptional escape. CONVENIENT LOCATION: • Camp Helen State Park - 2.5 miles • Alys Beach - 1.5 miles • Rosemary Beach - 0.5 miles • 30Avenue Shopping and Dining - 0.8 miles • The Big Chill - 3.5 miles
